newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Most CIS members have industry growth in Jan-July.
newsitem.headline: Most CIS members have industry growth in Jan-July.

text.p: Eight of the 12 members of the Commonwealth of Independent States recorded growth in industrial production in the first seven months of the year, the CIS Interstate Statistics Committee said on Tuesday.

But with the biggest member, Russia, still gripped by recession, output on average in the commonwealth in the first seven months fell three percent, compared with a 6.7 percent fall in the same 1995 period, it said in its latest bulletin.
The strongest growth was recorded in the Central Asian republics of Turkmenistan and Kyrgyzstan, recovering from steep declines a year earlier.
Industrial output was sharply lower in Tajikistan, which is suffering civil war.
Data from the committee also pointed to a sharp slowdown in inflation, with prices actually falling in five of the countries in July.
The CIS comprises all the republics of the former Soviet Union except the three Baltic states.
